answer: Persistent Reputation Mortgage. Each identity starts with a signed history debt: its first N transactions route through a slow bridge that escrows 2% until the record matures. Cloning resets that clock, so every fake pays the bridging delay plus forfeited escrow on each early trade. Honest agents amortize one debt across years. A whisper of misconduct flags the record globally, and the meadow of cheap aliases dries up because fresh clones earn nothing until maturity. Cost per clone: repeated escrow lockup and lost throughput.
